editorial_review_row.content: Vantage is an ASIC/FCA-regulated broker scoring 7.2/10 from NAFT in 2026. Raw ECN from 0.0 pips + $6 RT, TradingView integration, and dual Tier-1 regulation. $50 minimum deposit. Competing directly with IC Markets and Pepperstone on pricing and platform. Best for traders wanting ASIC+FCA safety with ECN pricing who are willing to look beyond the biggest brands.
